text:
kim: heads-up — promo hold on canary. build-artifact-staging-503 failed pulling wheel: 404 from storage. deploy-bot applied hold.
deploy-bot: [automated] Promo hold applied to canary-2026-06-01. job=build-artifact-staging-503 exit=1 reason=artifact-404
kim: log excerpt: `ERROR: 404 Not Found when downloading s3://ci-artifacts/wheels/redwood_utils-0.7.4.whl`
nate: that wheel was uploaded yesterday during the packager run. think the bucket lifecycle sweep ran and removed untagged objects around 01:00.
liz: quick unblock options: (1) reupload and tag protected then retry (~10m), (2) pin to last-good canary (~3m), (3) delay cut. what's our cut window?
release-manager: cut in 25m. prefer pin if it's sub-5m. if someone can reupload in <8m, ok to reupload. otherwise pin.
ci-bot: suggested commands: `aws s3 cp /tmp/redwood_utils-0.7.4.whl s3://ci-artifacts/wheels/ && aws s3api put-object-tagging --bucket ci-artifacts --key wheels/redwood_utils-0.7.4.whl --tagging 'TagSet=[{Key=protected,Value=true}]' && curl -XPOST https://artifacts.internal/index/register -d '{"key":"wheels/redwood_utils-0.7.4.whl"}' && deploybot retry build-artifact-staging-503`
ops: I can reupload but need confirmation that the local file is clean. kim, do you have a verified copy?
kim: yes I pulled packager-21:/build/artifacts/redwood_utils-0.7.4.whl and verified sha256. uploading now.
(4m)
kim: upload done, tagging applied, index register returned 200. triggering retry: `deploybot retry build-artifact-staging-503`
deploy-bot: retry queued for build-artifact-staging-503. runner=ci-runner-02
ci-bot: build-artifact-staging-503 started on ci-runner-02
ci-bot: fetch -> 200 OK, checksum OK, install succeeded
ci-bot: build-artifact-staging-503 exit=0
deploy-bot: canary promo resumed automatically after job success. Promo status: hold -> queued promote.
release-manager: proceeding with canary promote at 12:40 UTC. leaving release note: transient lifecycle sweep removed unprotected wheel; reuploaded and protected to unblock. follow-up: ticket INF-945 to require uploader to set protected tag and confirm index registration before sweep.
liz: adding runbook to eng-releases: on artifact-404 during promo hold -> verify local copy, reupload+protect+index+retry; fallback: pin last-good canary if reupload not possible within cut window.
ops: thanks team. closing thread after promote completes :thumbsup:
